title: Simulation 3D Actor
text: Create actors in 3D environment, 1 input, 1 output, {Operation} sets Operating mode of block Create at; {Actor Name} sets the name of actor, {Parent Name} sets the parent of actor, {Path to source file} sets the file from which actors are, {Initialization script} sets the code to initialize actor, {Sample time}, {Translation} sets the relative translation, {Rotation} sets the relative rotation, {Scale} sets the relative scale, {Input ports} sets the list of user-selected input ports text and {Output ports} sets the list of user-selected output ports text. Values come from the instance.
